findings.body: The new CLAUDECODE-dependent SDK checks and installation are cold-reader setup work, unrelated to this part's locking and process cleanup. They also require out-of-scope changes in tests/conftest.py and tests/test_codex_setup.py. The diagnostic wording changes at doctor.py:126–129 similarly introduce an unnecessary change to tests/test_setup.py. Remove these changes from this part while retaining codex.tidy() and the lifecycle tests.
findings.title: Simpler: unrelated doctor changes → existing setup behavior
